Term1: ORZID2 GMENU CAP OUTPATIENT TREATED SETTING
Text:
## COMMUNITY-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (CAP) TREATED WITH ORAL ANTIBIOTICS
## Previously healthy patients (i.e. no comorbidities):
(WITHOUT chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, renal failure,
congestive heart failure, malignancy, alcoholism, asplenia, immunosuppressing
conditions, or use of immunosuppressing drugs)
Preferred:
[Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h [DI] for 5 days](psjzid2-pna-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h-x5days)
< OR >
[Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO q8h [R] for 5 days](psjzid2-pna-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-q8h-x5days)
## Patients with comorbidities:
(WITH chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, renal failure, congestive
heart failure, malignancy, alcoholism, asplenia, immunosuppressing conditions or
use of immunosuppressing drugs)
Preferred:
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO Q12H [R] for 5 days <AND> azithromycin po](orz-set-abx-pna-amox-clav-875-po-q12h-azith-500mg-po-then-250mg)
once on day 1, then 250 mg PO QDAY for 4 days [M]
< OR >
[Cefdinir 300 mg PO Q12H [R] for 5 days <AND> azithromycin once on day 1, then](orz-set-abx-pna-cefdinir-300mg-bidx5d-azith-500mg-po-then-250mg)
250 mg PO QDAY for 4 days [M]
< OR >
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO Q12H [R] for 5 days <AND> doxycycline 100](orz-set-abx-pna-amox-clav-875-po-q12h-doxy-100mg-po-q12h-5days)
mg PO Q12H for 5 days [DI]
< OR >
[Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h [R] for 5 days <AND> doxycycline 100 mg PO Q12H for 5](orz-set-abx-pna-cefdinir-300mg-po-bid-doxy-100mg-po-q12h-5days)
days [DI]
## Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h [DI] for 5 days](psjzid2-pna-levofloxacin-750mg-po-q24h-x5days)

## COMMUNITY-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (CAP) TREATED WITH ORAL ANTIBIOTICS
Empirical regimens listed here cover the usual pathogens associated with CAP,
including atypical pathogens. Specific therapy should be guided by culture
results.
